en-US.description: Spec-first continuity framework for AI-assisted development
en-US.longDescription: Anchors ties spec, feature and test together through a shared identity code, then confronts each artifact against the rules declared in anchors.yaml. It maps the project as a graph, propagates change from the anchor outward, and gates every step — so work guided by AI stays anchored to what was decided.
en-US.name: Anchors
en-US.releaseNotes:
Fix: an operation's security schemes are required together
An API spec's ## Security table lists the schemes an operation requires. Each row compiled to an
item of its own under security:, and OpenAPI reads each item as an ALTERNATIVE. A client or a
gateway reading the document then accepted a call carrying any one of the schemes. At SS, a
session and an App Check, both required, compiled as either one.
The rows of a Security table now compile to one requirement holding every scheme, each with its
scopes:
security:
  - firebaseSession: []
    appCheck: []
A table with one row compiles as before.
Everything in the v0.1.351 notes still applies: run anchors migrate once, crossing format 8.
